ISRG_2011_p79__paragraph_3.ocr:
The aggregate intrinsic value of options exercised under our stock option plans determined as of the date of option exercise was $262.8 million, $192.9
million, and $94.9 million during the years ended December 31, 2011, 2010, and 2009, respectively. Cash received from option exercises and employee stock
purchase plans for the years ended December 31, 2011, 2010 and 2009 was $260.6 million, $141.1 million and $58.7 million, respectively.
